name: LoCoMo (Origin)
description: RerankMem hint mode evaluated on the original LoCoMo QA set (1986 questions), scored with the official snap-research token-F1 metric per question category. The adversarial category (5) is excluded from every row shown here — its near-zero refusal-style scores are not comparable to the other four categories, so headline/avg is the n-weighted mean over categories 1-4 only (1540 questions).
